seoContent.title: The future of race organization is here
seoContent.paragraph1: Athlifyr is a modern platform designed for sports event organizers who want to deliver a professional experience without the cost of traditional timing and tracking solutions. Whether you are organizing a local trail run, a city marathon, or a BTT enduro event, Athlifyr provides the tools you need — from online registration and route management to real-time GPS tracking and live results.
seoContent.paragraph2: With Athlifyr, spectators no longer have to wait at the finish line wondering where their athlete is. They can follow the race live on a map, receive push notifications at every checkpoint, and share the excitement on social media. For organizers, this means more engagement, more visibility, and happier participants.
seoContent.paragraph3: Our platform supports trail running, road racing, BTT, cycling, OCR, and triathlon events. The visual GPX route editor with checkpoint gate placement, combined with real-time GPS tracking and automatic leaderboard updates, makes Athlifyr the most complete free event management solution available today.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about organizing events with Athlifyr.
faq.q1: Is Athlifyr really free for event organizers?
faq.a1: Yes, 100% free. There are no setup fees, no monthly subscriptions, and no per-athlete charges. We only charge a small processing fee on paid registrations. Free events cost nothing at all.
faq.q2: What types of events can I organize?
faq.a2: Athlifyr supports trail running, road races, BTT/mountain biking, road cycling, OCR, triathlon, and any GPS-trackable endurance sport. From a 5K fun run to a 100-mile ultra trail — we've got you covered.
faq.q3: How does the live GPS tracking work?
faq.a3: Athletes use the Athlifyr mobile app during the race. Their GPS position is sent in real time to our servers, which update the live map and leaderboard. Spectators can follow the race from any web browser.
faq.q4: Do spectators need to install an app?
faq.a4: No! Spectators watch everything from the web browser. They can follow athletes on the map, see the leaderboard, and receive push notifications — all without installing anything.
faq.q5: How do athletes register for my event?
faq.a5: Athletes register through your event page on Athlifyr. You can set up multiple race variants, pricing phases with deadlines, and custom registration fields. Payments are processed securely via Stripe.
faq.q6: Can I export the results after the race?
faq.a6: Yes, you can export complete results in CSV and standard formats. Results include finish times, splits, rankings by category, and all checkpoint data.
faq.q7: What about the live streaming feature?
faq.a7: Live streaming is currently in development and will be available soon. It will allow you to stream finish line cameras, drone footage, and commentary directly through the Athlifyr event page.
